entities.summary: Nicola Filotesio was an Italian painter, architect and sculptor of the Renaissance period, active primarily in or near the town of Ascoli Piceno. Born in 1500, Filotesio was a prominent figure in the development of Mannerist art, known for his innovative use of perspective and composition. His works include the frescoes in the Basilica di San Francesco, which showcase his mastery of color and light. Filotesio's legacy can be seen in the many artists who followed in his footsteps, including Gian Lorenzo Bernini and Caravaggio. Despite his significant contributions to the art world, Filotesio's life was marked by personal struggles and financial difficulties. He died on September 10, 1547, in his hometown of Ascoli Piceno. Filotesio's art continues to be celebrated for its beauty and technical skill, inspiring generations of artists and art lovers alike.
